title: Barcelona Segway tour
text:
Great tour with an amazing guide Pau. Very knowledgeable guide with a passion for Barcelona. Really nice guy with a great attitude. Pau is a tremendous guide. 

Time wise we could only do the hour tour but would definitely do a longer tour if we had more time. Great way to see parts of the city. 

Gracias Pau 👌🏼

title: Beautiful day touring Barcelona
text:
A fantastic tour. We saw the beautiful city of Barcelona. Our tour guides Nuno and Bilal were very professional. 

Bilal was helping me manage my segway while Nuno was giving us a history lesson ashe showed us the sights. 

My friends and I had an amazing time. Thanks guys, keep up the good work.
author: E5298WHpetera

title: Great ride with Nuno on Segway
text: An incredible experience with an exceptional guide. A big thank you to Nuno who is very smiling and professional! Thanks again, JP and cece

title: Barcelona Segway
text: Can not fault this place, excellent time had by all.the your guide had lots to tell us and made us feel at ease
author: P5923URemilyr

title: Great experience!
text: We'll repeat. It has been a very rewarding and relaxing experience. We must mention the good treatment of the guide Zarina, of course when we return we will ask that she accompany us.
author: 924albertx

title: Twosome ride the Segway
text:
A great experience, also thanks to our super companion Mario. Completely relaxed we sped through Barcelona and enjoyed the area. Thanks to Mario, we also took home some great pictures. Had a road accident after the trip, mind you, after the trip, because I hadn't seen a curb. Mario stayed by our side, providing me with drinks and fanning air until I was safely transported to the hotel.
See you next year without curb but hopefully with Mario !!!!!
author: heikeundudo

title: PERFECT SEGWAY TRIP - THANKS TO OUR GUIDE ALP!
text:
We were on the last day of a two week trip.  We wanted something fun and pleasant, without a lot of talking.  Robot City and our guide Alp delivered perfectly. 
we have a younger family - they were patient to teach my youngest (age 11) and make sure we had experience before we went out.  I wanted a relaxing, fun ride - and they delivered as requested.  when we stopped for a couple of breaks, our guide Alp had some great knowledge about the detail of archeticture - and then we got back on our segways and went fast.   Thanks to the Robot city team- our best euro for euro experience in Spain.
author: partytimemoneky

title: Super way to see Barcelona
text: Even though we only had a one hour tour, we felt we got to see much of Barcelona. Me, my husbond, my 10 year old son and my 75 year old father had a super tour. I will do this again and then maybe a longer tour :-)
author: solvi_svendsen

title: To do
text:
Hello,
It is a very nice experience, I recommend. 
We took an hour-long tour, both children and adults had fun. 
If you spend several days in Barcelona, I recommend you do so at the beginning of your stay.
author: bertrandf431

title: 10/10! Brilliant experience
text: This was my second time to do the Segway tour in Barcelona. Both times I had Zarina as my tour guide - she was really friendly, passionate about Barcelona and she didn't rush us at all. Highly recommend!
author: conorf230
